name: Gordon W. Netzorg
tagline: Top rated Alternative Dispute Resolution attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Gordon W. Netzorg is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. He works at Taft Stettinius & Hollister LLP, located in Denver, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Alternative Dispute Resolution and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gordon Netzorg completed legal studies at Syracuse University College of Law and graduated with the class of 1976. Gordon Netzorg passed the bar in 1976.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
